title: Head of Watch Service Lucerne 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne

titleByLocale.en: Head of Watch Service Lucerne 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Overall responsibility for the operational management of the Watch Service Atelier in Lucerne, with a strong focus on quality, productivity, and on-time delivery
• Manage and optimize processes, resources, and workflows to achieve defined KPI targets
• Ensure and continuously develop quality standards and quality control processes
• Lead, coach, and develop the workshop team, both professionally and personally
• Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and continuously learning team culture
• Work closely with internal stakeholders and international service centers to implement global standards and best practices

What you bring to the role

• Completed apprenticeship as a Watchmaker (EFZ), specializing in after-sales service (Rhabillage) or industrial watchmaking
• Several years of professional experience in watch servicing, ideally complemented by leadership experience
• Additional training in leadership, management, or business administration is an advantage
• Strong leadership and communication skills, combined with a structured and analytical approach to work
• High quality orientation, entrepreneurial mindset, and experience collaborating with diverse teams and cultures
• Hands-on mentality, resilience, and a team-oriented personality focused on sustainable results and continuous improvement
• Fluent German and English language skills; knowledge of French is an asset

titleByLocale.de: Deputy Leiter Watch Service Lucerne 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Promotion of employees’ professional and personal development, as well as collaboration within the team
• Ensuring compliance with defined service and quality standards
• Deputy to the Head of Watch Service Lucerne
• Hands-on work in the workshop, including the execution of complex service operations on high-end timepieces
• Participation in the recruitment, onboarding, and training of employees
• Process optimization and active contribution to the ongoing development of the team and the department

What you bring to the role

• Completed qualification as a Watchmaker (or equivalent qualification), specializing in After-Sales Service (Rhabillage) or Industrial Watchmaking
• Several years of experience in watch service, ideally 5+ years
• Proven experience in a leadership role
• Strong communication skills, team-oriented mindset, and a high level of integrity, with the ability to lead by example
• A responsible and proactive approach, with a passion for supporting and developing employees
• Strong quality focus combined with a structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working
• Fluent German and English skills; French is an advantage

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Responsible for the administrative management of the Watch Service, with a focus on the Swiss market
• Coordination and monitoring of internal and external repair schedules
• Maintenance and assurance of high-quality customer, product, and order data within the repair management system
• Ensuring, optimizing, and continuously developing existing processes
• Acting as the escalation point for complex customer inquiries and concerns
• Managing and monitoring service orders throughout the entire repair process
• Further developing quality standards to ensure an excellent Watch Service customer journey
• Contributing to the development and enhancement of Power BI reporting and the analysis of relevant KPIs
• Participating in and taking partial responsibility for global projects
• Deputizing for the Global Head of Watch Service Administration in administrative and coordination-related matters

What you bring to the role

Commercial apprenticeship or retail-specific vocational qualification (EFZ) supplemented by further education in business administration or project management (e.g., Federal Diploma of Higher Education, HF Diploma, or equivalent qualification)
• Several years of professional experience in a demanding administrative role, ideally within the luxury goods industry
• Experience in supporting, coordinating, or taking partial responsibility for projects
• Strong ERP system knowledge, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations; Power BI knowledge is an advantage
• Excellent written and spoken German and English skills (C1 level); French and additional languages are considered an asset
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to think holistically and identify interconnected relationships
• High level of resilience, ability to work under pressure, and confidence in decision-making, including in deputy and escalation situations
• Independent, customer-oriented, and assertive personality with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and proactive approach to work

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Lead and develop a team of two employees within the Sourcing and GemLab function
• Implement and further develop sourcing strategies
• Coordinate customer inquiries and manage the quotation process
• Source gemstones and diamonds for stock, bespoke orders, and sales activities
• Support Category Management in assortment and sourcing-related topics
• Maintain and further develop supplier relationships
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional internal stakeholders
• Drive continuous improvement of processes and workflows within the area of responsibility

What you bring to the role

• Commercial vocational training combined with further education in business administration
• Several years of professional experience in the jewellery, gemstone, or diamond industry
• Solid expertise in gemstones and diamonds; gemmological training is an advantage
• Enthusiasm for leading and developing a small team
• Entrepreneurial mindset, strong initiative, and a hands-on approach
• Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills
• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken

title: Global Head of System Engineering 100% (m/w/d) - Lucerne

titleByLocale.en: Global Head of System Engineering 100% (m/w/d) - Lucerne

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us
• Providing technical and managerial leadership to the global systems engineering team (3–5 staff)
• Coaching, developing and supporting team members
• Ensuring the stable and secure operation of the global Microsoft infrastructure
• Further developing the global infrastructure, platform and operations strategy
• Actively shaping the transformation towards hybrid and cloud infrastructures
• Defining and establishing global standards, governance and operational models
• Working closely with internal specialist departments (Security, Network, Cloud, Workplace, Business Applications) and international teams, particularly in North America
• Managing external partners and ensuring reliable delivery
• Evaluating new technologies and continuously optimising and automating the infrastructure
• Communicating complex technical topics clearly to various stakeholders

What you bring to the role
• Several years’ experience in setting up and operating complex Microsoft infrastructures
• Excellent knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID, hybrid identity and Azure
• Experience with Windows Server, VMware vSphere, PKI (AD CS), DNS/DHCP and Azure Infrastructure Services
• Experience in cloud transformations and modern infrastructure architecture
• Good knowledge of security, compliance, governance and operational requirements
• Experience with automation, ideally Infrastructure as Code and scripting
• Several years’ leadership experience (approx. 5 years) in technical infrastructure teams
• Hands-on approach with high technical credibility
• Structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented working style
• Strong communication skills and a passion for international collaboration and change

title: Global IT System Engineer Network 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne

titleByLocale.en: Global IT System Engineer Network 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne
titleByLocale.it: Global IT System Ingegnere Network 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne
titleByLocale.de: Global IT System Ingenieur Network 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne
titleByLocale.fr: Global IT System Ingénieur Network 100% (m/w/d) – Lucerne

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Independent planning, implementation and management of global IT projects in the areas of networking, WLAN and IP telephony
• Installation, configuration and operation of network components with a focus on Cisco and Fortinet
• Further development and implementation of global network and security concepts for high availability, stability and scalability
• Administration, monitoring and troubleshooting of the international LAN/WLAN infrastructure (Cisco hardware & software)
• Automation and scripting (e.g. with Ansible, Python) for standardisation and increased efficiency
• Compliance with and monitoring of IT security standards, including firewall, VPN and access control concepts
• Carrying out installations and technical assignments in our international sales outlets
• Collaboration with internal departments as well as external service providers and partners
• Collaboration in global incident, problem and change processes in accordance with ITIL standards

Your skills

• Completed IT training or comparable qualification and at least 3 years of professional experience in the network environment
• Very good knowledge of routing, switching, WLAN, VLAN design and network security
• Several years of experience with Cisco (switching/wireless/VoIP) and ideally Fortinet
• In-depth experience with firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN and monitoring tools (e.g. PRTG, SolarWinds, Cisco Identity Services Engine)
• Good knowledge of scripting & automation (Ansible, Python)
• Confident written and spoken German and English
• Strong service orientation, analytical thinking, ability to work in a team and a proactive approach to work
• Willingness to travel internationally (EU/UK/US) and take on on-call duty

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us

• Take responsibility for demand planning as well as the definition, development, and optimization of product assortments for our partner brands, including lifecycle management
• Manage and monitor relevant KPIs (sales revenue, sales volume, inventory levels, stock turnover, and margin), and conduct regular assortment and product analyses
• Act as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders and assigned partner brands
• Ensure an attractive and customer-oriented product presentation through the optimal curation of assortments

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role with us
• Responsibility for the efficient handling of all warehouse processes (goods receipt, putaway, order picking and dispatch)
• You will provide support as required across all operational areas (stand-in role)
• Ensuring timely and high-quality order processing, particularly of customer orders
• Monitoring, managing and optimising stock levels, including carrying out stock-takes
• Analysing existing warehousing processes and continuously developing and optimising them (e.g. LEAN approaches)
• Working closely with the Purchasing and Sales departments
• Ensuring compliance with quality and safety regulations
• Supporting the Warehousing Team Lead with optimisation projects and the development and maintenance of key performance indicators
• Assisting with the training of logistics apprentices

What you bring to the role
• A completed qualification in logistics (e.g. Logistics Specialist EFZ) or a technical/commercial qualification with relevant practical experience in logistics
• Several years’ professional experience in warehouse logistics
• A high degree of flexibility combined with a quick grasp of processes and expertise in all operational areas of logistics
• Experience in using warehouse management systems (e.g. SAP, WMS or Microsoft Dynamics)
• Good knowledge of MS Office (particularly Excel)
• Very good command of German and a basic knowledge of English
• Further training in logistics or supply chain management would be an advantage
• Strong IT skills and a passion for working with systems
• Strong process-oriented mindset and knowledge of LEAN management
• Structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work
• Analytical thinking and a good understanding of interrelationships
• Ability to work in a team, assertiveness, and a high degree of reliability and sense of responsibility
